title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
description: ⁠Nvidia has made clear⁠ it won’t backstop an AI data center until it’s nearly ready to run, and that’s landing just as neoclouds report construction delays and more expensive debt. The message to developers is that land, power, and a finished building matter more than a pitch deck.  ⁠Anita Verma-Lallian⁠ has been selling exactly that. […]
